title: From farms to high schools, France is a nation on edge
subhead: The country is wavering between revolt and despair as it faces a whirlwind of crises: devastating heatwaves, spiralling debt, spiking interest rates, rising cost of living, housing shortages, increasing unemployment and protests over conditions in high schools.

title: Saudi Arabia weighs response after Houthi attack on Riyadh, deadliest in a decade

title: 'We are still in the Middle Ages': Women on sexual violence in e-sports
subhead: Le Monde has learned that a well-known League of Legends streamer and commentator was charged with rape in July. The case is indicative of sexual violence in e-sports, a male-dominated sector in which women's voices often go unheard.

title: France investigates Thales contracts in Azerbaijan denounced by jailed former employee
subhead: 'A forgotten Frenchman in Baku' (2/2). Mehmet Sahan, a French-Turkish dual national detained in Azerbaijan since early 2022 after a complaint by Thales, has alleged corruption. French prosecutors, who searched the premises of the defense giant in 2024, are investigating the contracts in question.

Le Monde traced nine years of correspondence between the two men, from their first meeting to Epstein's death in 2019.

title: How the French left wants to reclaim the idea of the nation
subhead: Although the concept of the nation was born during the French Revolution, the far right has claimed it since the end of the 20th century. Nevertheless, the left has never completely abandoned patriotism. The current presidential campaign proves as much.

title: Hasan Piker, the controversial streamer seducing America's radical left
subhead: The 35-year-old has established himself on Twitch as one of the most-followed political commentators in the US. A socialist, he enjoys the support of the most radical wing of the Democratic Party. But that support is not unanimous, as his comments on Israel and Jews have led to accusations of antisemitism.
